# One at a Time

*Nessa takes quay children out in the pilot boats at slack, one at a time, and wants an honest second opinion. Ask Kor which child he would put on an oar, then see that child.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Nessa](../npcs/warden_nessa.md) |

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Kor](../npcs/warden_kor.md)
2. Talk to [Arlo](../npcs/arlo_child.md)

    - I want a second opinion, and I'll not get an honest one at the table. Ask [Kor](../npcs/warden_kor.md) which of the quay children he'd put on an oar. Then go and see whoever he names, and come back and tell me.
